lines.text: In the second year after leaving Egypt, the LORD tells Moses in the Tent of Meeting to count men twenty or older.
One leader from each tribe assists, such as Elizur of Reuben and Nahshon of Judah, and Moses and Aaron take them.
Moses counts the tribes in the Wilderness of Zin, beginning with Reuben, and Judah numbers 74,600.
Moses, Aaron and the twelve leaders count 603,550 men, but the Levites are not numbered with them.
God appoints the Levites over the tabernacle, and they camp around the tabernacle so no wrath falls on Israel.
